description:
Send a supplier Privi's ten post-quantum questions, then score the answers 0-100 with a letter grade and
a ranked list of gaps. The scorecard is signed (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-87) so the supplier can show it to other
customers. Call with no arguments to get the questions.

answers.description: Question id -> yes | partial | planned | no
answers.title: Answers

evidence.description: Optional: question id -> SHA-256 fingerprint of the supplier's evidence document
evidence.title: Evidence

supplier.description: Supplier's company name. Omit (with answers) to get the questionnaire
supplier.title: Supplier

name: pqc_supplier_score
title: Score a supplier's post-quantum readiness
